text_block_list.text:
—Christmas. The students of Tracen Academy 
all enjoy their time in their own special 
ways.
Those reveling in the glamorous party.

Others busying themselves with delivering 
presents.

"No one spends their time all alone here. 
Or at least, that's how it should be..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Auu~, I kinda messed up, or rather, things 
just sort of ended up this way~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
We were talking about having a Christmas 
party with friends, but... I kind of had a 
bad feeling about it, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Less like canceled and more like fizzled 
out, I guess... In other words, you see...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
We did say we'd do it, but... I kind of 
thought someone else would just get the 
ball rolling~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And then, everyone started taking a 
wait-and-see approach. I started worrying 
about what we'd do if no one showed up, 
and...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So basically, since we haven't prepared 
anything, it's time for an imaginary 
Christmas~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even if I had a hunch, I don't really have 
the drive to take charge myself~. Ahaha...

...It seems I have been forced into a 
lonely Christmas. In that case...
choice_data_list: ...Want to go grab a bite to eat?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...!? A-Are you sure it's okay?
choice_data_list: Yeah, if you're free, that is.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm free! Super free! Ehehe, then don't 
mind if I do~!

And so, I ended up spending Christmas with 
Hishi Miracle, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Man, Christmas just isn't complete 
without fried chicken! It's the absolute 
best, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, did you know? Apparently people 
in other countries don't eat chicken on 
Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I kind of wonder the opposite, though~. 
Why *wouldn't* you eat chicken on 
Christmas?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Because it's delicious. Though fried 
chicken is nice too..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The illuminations around the neighborhood 
are nice too, aren't they? They're just so 
sparkling and bright~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wanna strike a pose in front of the 
display window for some Insta-worthy 
shots~? I'd normally be too embarrassed, 
though!

Even though they weren't doing anything 
special, Hishi Miracle remained in high 
spirits the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, is this kind of thing...?
choice_data_list:
Like more famous spots, or fancy 
restaurants...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah... I do look up to them, though~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, you know, wouldn't that just make 
you nervous? Rather than something like 
that...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I guess it's just more fun for me to goof 
around with people I already know."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Because it's way more fun that way. Just 
blurting it out and having a good laugh."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: So today—is the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
To go from spending Christmas alone to 
such an incredible turnaround feels like a 
dream!

A word with far too broad a meaning. Small 
dreams, big dreams, and everything in 
between. But...

These everyday moments might just be Hishi 
Miracle's dream.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'm satisfied with this sort of thing, 
but other Umamusume might feel 
differently."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Working hard to get invited to fancy 
parties, or training today, for example.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I respect them, sure... but it just 
doesn't really click with me, y'know...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I think I might have found it. 
My dream.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. I'm sure I'm the only one who truly 
feels this way, though."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Maybe I'll carry this on my back 
and head to the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I can shoulder this much on my own, and 
besides, I really want to make it come 
true!

It seemed Hishi Miracle had unexpectedly 
stumbled upon the dream of her own that 
she'd been searching for all along.
—On the way back.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, on our way home, let's buy 
strawberry shortcake at the convenience 
store as a treat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The delicious two-pack kind! Let's kick 
off round two of our Christmas party with 
this~. Hehehe~!

"A convenience store cake hyped her up 
even more. Hishi Miracle seemed to be 
having fun the entire time."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Trainer-san, there's a huge line over 
there...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"They're selling something. 'Year-End 
Lucky Lottery', huh..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
When you see a line, doesn't it feel like 
you're missing out if you don't join it?

And so, the two of them gazed deeply at 
the lucky lottery tickets they bought 
together...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Normally... you wouldn't win, right? Like, 
first prize and all.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it won't hit at all.
Yeah, there's basically no chance it hits.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
But you know what? I am a Miracle 
Umamusume, after all. Nobody expected me 
to make it this far either.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Who knows, it might just happen, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~, guess I'll shoot for 1st prize. 
If I win...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A multi-million-dollar luxury condo! You 
could even buy one of those! You'd 
officially join the ranks of the 
celebrities!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You'd be able to live with us too, 
Trainer. If we win, we split it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"If we hit the jackpot, should we buy it~? 
Should we move in~?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing just fine. Every day is lots of 
fun.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: No, no, no...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: No, no, no, no...

Even before anyone gets hit, a relentless 
back-and-forth of "no, no, no" ensues. 
However...

"Could she actually pull it off...? 
Looking at Hishi Miracle, I somehow 
couldn't help but feel that way."
